profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer at CPI
profile.summary: I started as a Software engineer and migrated into Firmware. I have really enjoyed the low level development, so I desire to pursue a career in Hardware development as well. I've worked in an aerospace environment, oil and gas, and logistics, so I'm not too concerned about a particular industry. My main goal is to put myself on a career path where I can grow my skills and be involved in a design/development process.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Day-to-day tasks include maintaining and developing code for the various products that control and interface with a variety of antenna systems.
